sql: SELECT firstName, lastName, deathYear - birthYear FROM Master WHERE shootCatch IS NULL AND deathYear IS NOT NULL
SELECT T1.firstName, T1.lastName FROM Master T1 JOIN Goalies T2 ON T1.playerID=T2.playerID WHERE T2.lgID IN ('PCHA','NHL') GROUP BY T2.playerID HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT T2.lgID)=2

SELECT T1.firstName, T1.lastName, T2.year, AVG(T2.Min) FROM Master T1 JOIN Goalies T2 ON T1.playerID=T2.playerID WHERE T1.playerID=(SELECT playerID FROM Goalies GROUP BY playerID ORDER BY COUNT(playerID) DESC LIMIT 1) GROUP BY T1.firstName, T1.lastName, T2.year

SELECT DISTINCT T1.firstName, T1.lastName, T3.name FROM Master T1 JOIN Goalies T2 ON T1.playerID=T2.playerID JOIN Teams T3 ON T2.tmID=T3.tmID AND T2.year=T3.year WHERE T1.deathYear IS NOT NULL AND T1.birthCountry='Canada' AND T1.pos='G'
SELECT T1.nameGiven, T2.tmID, T2.year FROM Master T1 JOIN Coaches T2 ON T1.coachID=T2.coachID WHERE T1.playerID IS NOT NULL AND T1.coachID IS NOT NULL
SELECT T1.nameGiven, CAST(SUM(T2.Min) AS REAL)/SUM(T2.GP) FROM Master T1 JOIN Goalies T2 ON T1.playerID=T2.playerID WHERE T1.playerID='aebisda01' GROUP BY T1.playerID
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.coachID) FROM Coaches T1 JOIN Master T2 ON T1.coachID=T2.coachID WHERE T1.w>30 AND T2.birthCountry='USA'
SELECT T1.firstName FROM Master T1 JOIN HOF T2 ON T1.hofID=T2.hofID WHERE T1.shootCatch IS NULL
SELECT W FROM Goalies WHERE playerID='vanbijo01' AND year=1990
SELECT T1.w FROM Coaches T1 JOIN AwardsCoaches T2 ON T1.coachID=T2.coachID AND T1.year=T2.year WHERE T2.year=1933 AND T2.award='Second Team All-Star'
